AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: To analyzed the clinical features of children with HFMD and viral encephalitis and to summarize some treatments.

AbstractText.Label: PATIENTS AND METHODS
AbstractText.content: A total of 59 children with HFMD were included in this study. All children underwent complete blood count, blood biochemical test cerebrospinal fluid examination, chest X-ray and brain MRI.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: One child died 24 hours after admission due to central respiratory failure with myocardial damage. After the treatment, 58 children had normal temperature, resolved rash, normal complete blood count, biochemical blood tests and cerebrospinal fluid test, respiratory and circulatory symptoms and signs, as well as neurological symptoms, disappeared. The hospitalization time was 12-21 days. After follow-up for 1-3 months, all children were recovered, and without any severe sequelae.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSIONS
AbstractText.content: HFMD and the complicated viral encephalitis usually occurred in the children < 3 years old. The clinical manifestations were not typical. Monitoring of the child's clinical symptoms, signs and relevant examinations was required.
